newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Paul Y takes stake in HK property firm.
newsitem.headline: Paul Y takes stake in HK property firm.

text.p: Civil engineering concern Paul Y - ITC Construction Holdings Ltd has agreed to buy a 50 percent stake in a property firm Oregon Holdings Ltd from an independent third party for HK$360 million, Paul Y said on Wednesday.
The remaining 50 percent of Oregon will continue to be held by the third party, Paul Y said.

Paul Y said HK$180 million would be paid in cash and the remaining HK$180 million would be satisfied by an issue of loan note carrying an interest at the rate of eight percent per annum with maturity on August 12, 1997.
The company said it has an option to repay the loan by issuing new shares at HK$2.00 per share. The new shares will represent 7.9 percent of Paul Y's enlarged issued share capital.

Oregon engages in joint development in certain properties at Hung To Road in Hong Kong's Kwun Tong district. The properties comprise a redevelopment site area of 2,785 square metres for a proposed industrial and office development.
